name: io.github.IBM/mdm-mcp-server
title: IBM MDM MCP Server
description: Search and manage IBM Master Data Management data on IBM Cloud or IBM Software Hub.

environmentVariables.name: M360_TARGET_PLATFORM
environmentVariables.description: IBM deployment platform: cloud for IBM Cloud or cpd for IBM Software Hub.

environmentVariables.name: API_CLOUD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: IBM MDM API base URL. Required when M360_TARGET_PLATFORM is cloud.

environmentVariables.name: API_CLOUD_AUTH_URL
environmentVariables.description: IBM Cloud IAM token endpoint. Required when M360_TARGET_PLATFORM is cloud.

environmentVariables.name: API_CLOUD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: IBM Cloud API key. Required when M360_TARGET_PLATFORM is cloud.

environmentVariables.name: API_CLOUD_CRN
environmentVariables.description: IBM MDM instance CRN. Required when M360_TARGET_PLATFORM is cloud.

environmentVariables.name: API_CPD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: IBM MDM API base URL on Software Hub. Required when M360_TARGET_PLATFORM is cpd.

environmentVariables.name: API_CPD_AUTH_URL
environmentVariables.description: Software Hub authentication endpoint. Required when M360_TARGET_PLATFORM is cpd.

environmentVariables.name: API_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Software Hub username. Required when M360_TARGET_PLATFORM is cpd.

environmentVariables.name: API_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Software Hub password. Required when M360_TARGET_PLATFORM is cpd.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOLS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool exposure mode: minimal for core tools or full for all available tools.
